data.contenido:
Saul okwa ningi omukwaniilwa gwotango gwaIsrael. Ihe Jehova okwe mu ekelehi, David noye a hogololwa a kale omukwaniilwa pehala lye. Tse otatu ilongo oshindji kombinga yaDavid. Manga ye a li omulumentu omugundjuka, okwa kondjitha omulefule Goliat. Konima ye okwa yi Omukwaniilwa omunefupa Saul ontuku. Opo nduno Abigael omwaanawa okwe mu kankameke okuninga iinima ya nika uugoya.

Tashi landula ko tse otatu ki ilonga iinima oyindji kombinga yomwanamati gwaDavid Salomo, ngoka a ningi omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael pehala lyaDavid. Aakwaniilwa yatatu yotango yaIsrael kehe gumwe okwa pangele uule woomvula 40. Konima yeso lyaSalomo, Israel okwa topolwa momaukwaniilwa gaali, uukwaniilwa wokuumbangalantu nowokuumbugantu.

Uukwaniilwa womazimo 10 wokuumbangalantu owa kala po oomvula 257 omanga inaawu hanagulwa po kAayassur. Nokonima yoomvula 133 uukwaniilwa womazimo gaali gokuumbugantu nawo wo owa hanagulwa po. Oshikando shika Aaisrael oya falwa kuBabilon oyo oonkwatwa. Ano Oshitopolwa OSHITINE otashi hokolola oomvula 510 dhondjokonona, sho iiningomwa oyindji iituntulimwenyo tayi ningwa.

TALA nkene Samuel ta tile omugwayo momutse gwomulumentu. Shika osho yo haa ningile omuntu okuulika kutya ye okwa hogololwa oye omukwaniilwa. Jehova ota lombwele Samuel a tile omugwayo momutse gwaSaul. Ogwo omugwayo gwi ikalekelwa ngoka gwa nika nawa.

Saul ka li a dhiladhila kutya ye omwaanawa a gwana okukala omukwaniilwa. ‘Ngame ondomezimo lyaBenjamin, eshonashona muIsrael,’ ye ta ti kuSamuel. ‘Omolwashike to ti kutya ngame otandi ka kala omukwaniilwa?’ Jehova oku hole Saul molwashoka ye ihi iningi ongaangoka omunene nenge a simana. Shika osho molwashono Ye te mu hogolola a kale omukwaniilwa.

Ihe Saul ke shi ohepele nenge omushona. Ye okwa za muukwanegumbo uuyamba, noye omulumentu e na ondjelo ombwaanawa nomule noonkondo. Ye omule e vule ayehe muIsrael! Saul oha vulu wo okumatuka a mana mo noku na oonkondo odhindji. Aantu oya nyanyukwa sho Jehova a hogolola Saul oye omukwaniilwa. Yo ayehe otaa tameke tayi igidha: ‘Omukwaniilwa na kale nomwenyo omule!’

Aatondi yaIsrael natango oye na oonkondo ngaaka ngaashi shito. Yo otaye etele natango Aaisrael uupyakadhi owindji. Mbala sho Saul a gwayekwa omukwaniilwa, Aayamoni otaa yi ye ke ya kondjithe. Ihe Saul ota gongele etanga enene nota dhenge Aayamoni. Shika otashi nyanyudha aantu noonkondo sho Saul oye omukwaniilwa.

Molweendo lwoomvula Saul ota wilike Aaisrael ya sinde aatondi yawo iikando oyindji. Saul oku na wo omumati ependa gwedhina Jonatan. Jonatan nota kwatha Israel okusinda omalugodhi ogendji. Aafilisti natango oyo aatondi aanenenene yAaisrael. Esiku limwe omayuvi lwomayuvi gAafilisti otage ya okukondjitha Aaisrael.

Samuel ota lombwele Saul a tegelele sigo ye te ya nota ningile Jehova eyambo nenge omagano. Ihe Samuel ite ya mbala. Saul okwa tila kutya Aafilisti otaye ke ya ponokela, nota ningi ye mwene eyambo. Lwahugunina sho Samuel e ya, ye ota ti kuSaul kutya ye okwa li inaa vulika. ‘Jehova ota ka hogolola omuntu gulwe oye omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael,’ Samuel ta ti.

Konima Saul okwa kala ishewe inaa vulika. Ano Samuel ote mu lombwele: ‘Oshi li nawa okukala to vulika kuJehova shi vulithe oku mu yambela onzi ombwanawa. Molwashoka ngoye ino vulika kuJehova, Jehova ite ku kaleke omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael.’

Tse otatu vulu okwiilonga oshilongwa oshiwanawa muka. Otashi tu ulukile nke-ne sha simana okuvulika aluhe kuJehova. Notashi ulike kutya omuntu omwaanawa, ngaashi Saul a li, ota vulu okulunduluka nota ningi omwiinayi. Tse inatu hala nando okuninga aawinayi, hasho mbela? 1 Samuel ontopolwa 9 sigo 11; 13:5-14; 14:47-52; 15:1-35; 2 Samuel 1:23.

NGOYE oto vulu mbela okumona shoka sha ningwa po? Omumati okwa hupitha okanzi haka okashona kemwanka. Emwanka olya ndjindji po okanzigona li ke ka lye po. Ihe omumati okwa matuka konima yawo nokwa hupitha okanzigona mokana kemwanka. Naashono emwanka lya thikama, omumati okwa kwata emwanka nokwe li dhipaga! Oshikando shimwe ye okwa hupitha yimwe yomoonzi konkoshi. Ye omumati ependa, hasho mbela? Owa tseya kutya oye lye?

Oye omugundjuka David. Ye okwa kala mondoolopa yaBetlehem. Hekulu okwa li Obed, omwanamati gwaRut naBoas. Oto ya dhimbulukwa mbela? Nahe yaDavid oIsai. David oha tonatele oonzi dhahe. David okwa valwa konima yoomvula 10 sho Jehova a hogolola Saul a kale omukwaniilwa.

Ethimbo olya thikana opo Jehova a tye kuSamuel: ‘Kutha omugwayo gwi ikalekelwa nou ye kegumbo lyaIsai muBetlehem. Ngame onda hogolola gumwe gwomoyanamati a kale omukwaniilwa.’ Sho Samuel e wete omwanamati gwaIsai gwosheeli Eliab, ye oti ipopile: ‘Oye shili gumwe ngoka Jehova a hogolola.’ Ihe Jehova ota ti kuye: ‘Ino tala uule we nolupe lwe. Ngame inandi mu hogolola a kale omukwaniilwa.’

Isai oti ithana omwanamati Abinadab note mu eta kuSamuel. Ihe Samuel ota ti: ‘Aawe, naanguka Jehova ine mu hogolola.’ Opo nduno Isai ote eta omwanamati Samma. ‘Aawe, naanguka Jehova ine mu hogolola,’ Samuel ta ti. Isai ote eta oyanamati yaheyali kuSamuel, ihe Jehova ina hogolola nando ogumwe gwomuyo. ‘Oyo ayeke aamati mbano?’ Samuel ta pula.

‘Opu na natango onkelo,’ Isai ta ti. ‘Ihe ye ota tonatele oonzi.’ Sho David e etwa mo, Samuel ota vulu okumona kutya ye omumati omwaanawa. ‘Oye ngoka,’ Jehova ta ti. ‘Mu gwayeka omugwayo.’ Nosho shoka Samuel ta ningi. Esiku limwe David ota ka ninga omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael. 1 Samuel 17:34, 35; 16:1-13.

AAFILISTI otaye ya ishewe okukondjitha Israel. Ngashingeyi aamwayinamati yaDavid aakuluntu yatatu oye li metanga lyaakwiita lyaSaul. Ano esiku limwe Isai ota ti kuDavid: ‘Fala iishunga niikwiila kaamwanyoko. Tala nkene ye li po.’

Sho David ta thiki pontanda yetanga lyaakwiita, ye ota matukile kelondo oku ka konga aamwayina. Ofule Omufilisti Goliat ota piti mo okusheka Aaisrael. Ye ote shi ningi ngashingeyi uule womasiku 40 ongula nongulohi kehe. Ye oti igidha: ‘Hogololeni omulumentu gumwe gwomaalumentu yeni e ye a kondjithe ndje. Ngele ye ota sindi ndje nota dhipaga ndje, tse otatu ka kala aapika yeni. Ihe ngele ngame otandi mu sindi notandi mu dhipaga, ne otamu ka kala aapika yetu. Ngame otandi mu shongo mu hogolole gumwe e ye a kondjithe ndje.’ David ota pula gumwe gwomaakwiita: ‘Omulumentu ngoka ta ka dhipaga Omufilisti nguka nota kutha po ohoni ndjika yaIsrael ota ka pewa shike?’

‘Saul ota ka yambapaleka omulumentu ngoka noonkondo,’ omukwiita ta ti. ‘Nota ka gandja omwanakadhona a ninge omukiintu gwe.’

Ihe Aaisrael ayehe oya tila Goliat molwashoka ye omunene ngawo. Ye oku na konyala uule woometa 3 noha humbatitha omukwiita gulwe ehuyanza lye.

Yalwe yomaakwiita otaa yi ya ka lombwele Omukwaniilwa Saul kutya David okwa hala a kondje naGoliat. Ihe Saul ota ti kuDavid: ‘Ngoye ito vulu okukondjitha Omufilisti nguka. Ngoye omumati owala, ye okwa kala nale uule wonkalamwenyo ye ayihe omukwiita.’ David ota yamukula: ‘Ngame onda dhipaga emwanka nonkoshi mbyoka ya ndjindjile po oonzi dhatate. Osho naanaa tashi ka ningilwa Omufilisti nguka ngaashi yimwe yomuyo ye shi ningilwa. Jehova ota ka kwatha ndje.’ Saul ota ti: ‘Inda, Jehova na kale pamwe nangoye.’

David ota yi kokalonga nota toola uumanya utano uuthenu note wu tula mompunda ye. Opo nduno ota kutha oshidhaadhigitho she note ende ta ka tsakaneka ofule. Sho Goliat te mu mono, ita vulu oku shi zimina. Ye ota dhiladhila kutya otashi ka kala oshipu lela okudhipaga David.

‘Ila kungame,’ Goliat ta ti, ‘ngame ndi vule okugandja olutu lwoye koondhila nokiilikama yi ku lye po.’ Ihe David ota ti: ‘Ngoye oto ya kungame negongamwele nonegonga neshigombanza, ihe ngame otandi ya kungoye medhina lyaJehova. Nena Jehova ote ke ku gandja miikaha yandje notandi ke ku lefula.’

Opo tuu mpono David ota matuka u uka kuGoliat. Ota kutha emanya mompunda ye, te li tula moshidhaadhigitho she note li dhaadhiga noonkondo dhe adhihe. Emanya otali yi lyu ukilila momutse gwaGoliat, nota gu a sa! Sho Aafilisti ye wete kutya ofule yawo oya sa, yo ayehe otaya piluka notaa fadhuka po. Aaisrael otaye ya landula notaa sindana molugodhi. 1 Samuel 17:1-54.

data.titulo: Molwashike David E Na Okuya Ontuku
data.contenido:
KONIMA sho David a dhipaga Goliat, mwene gwetanga lyaakwiita lyaIsrael Abner ote mu eta kuSaul. Saul okwa panda David noonkondo. Ote mu ningi mwene gwetanga lye lyaakwiita note mu etha a kale muuwa.

Konima sho etanga lyaakwiita tali galuka kolugodhi lwokukondjitha Aafilisti, aakiintu otayi imbi: ‘Saul okwa dhenge omayuvi, ihe David omayuvi omulongo.’ Shika otashi sitha Saul efupa, oshoka yo otaa gandja esimano olindji kuDavid shi vulithe kuSaul. Ihe omwanamati gwaSaul Jonatan ye ina sa efupa. Ye oku hole David noonkondo, David naye wo oku hole Jonatan. Ano mbaka yaali otayi iyu-vanekele kutya yo otaa ka kala ookuumethane aluhe. David oha hiki oka-humba nawa unene noo-nkondo, na Saul oku hole oomusika ndhoka ye ha hiki. Ihe esiku limwe efupa lyaSaul olye mu ningitha sha oshitilithi. Manga David ta hiki okahumba, Saul ota kutha egonga lye nota dhaadhiga omanga ye ta ti: ‘Otandi ululile David kekuma!’ Ihe David ota yanda, negonga otali mu palutha. Konima Saul ota dhaadhiga ishewe David, negonga lye otali palutha. Ngashingeyi David oku shi shi kutya ye oku na okukala a kotoka noonkondo.

Oto dhimbulukwa mbela euvaneko ndyono Saul a ningi? Ye oku uvaneke okugandja omwanakadhona komu-lumentu ngoka ta dhipaga Goliat. Lwahugunina Saul ota ti kuDavid kutya ye ota vulu okumona omwanakadhona Mikal, ihe ye oku na tango okudhipaga aatondi Aafilisti 100. Dhiladhila kwaashino! Muushili wo wene Saul okwi inekela kutya Aafilisti otaa ka dhipaga David. Ihe itashi ningwa, ano Saul ota gandja omwanakadhona kuDavid a kale omukiintu gwe.

Esiku limwe Saul ota ti kuJonatan nokaapiya ye ayehe kutya ye okwa hala okudhipaga David. Ihe Jonatan ota ti kuhe: ‘Ino ningila David sha. Ye ina yona nando kungoye. Ashihe shoka ye a ningi, osha li owala ekwatho enene kungoye. Ye okwa li a hupula omwenyo gwe sho ye a dhipaga Goliat, naashono we shi mono, owa li wa nyanyukwa.’

Saul ota pulakene komwana, notu uvaneke okwaaningila David sha. David ota galulwa, nota longele Saul megumbo lye ngaashi naanaa shito. Ihe manga David ta dhana omusika, Saul ota dhaadhiga ishewe egonga kuDavid. David ota yanda, negonga otali tsu mekuma. Shika oshikando oshititatu! Ngashingeyi David oku shi shi kutya ye oku na okuya ontuku!

Uusiku owo tuu mbo-ka David ota yi kegumbo lye. Ihe Saul ota tumu aalumentu oku ke mu dhipaga. Mikal oku shi shoka he ta dhiladhila. Ano ota ti komulumentu gwe: ‘Ngele ngoye ito yi ontuku uusiku wonena, ongula oto si.’ Uusiku mbono Mikal ota kwatha David okufadhuka po ta pitile mekende. Konyala uule woo-mvula heyali David e na oku-holama okuza pehala limwe nokuya kulilwe opo Saul kaa vule oku mu mona. 1 Samuel 18:1-30; 19:1-18.

OWA tseya kutya omukiintu ngoka omwaanawa te ya kuDavid oye lye? Edhina lye oAbigail. Ye omunandunge, nota keelele opo David kaa ninge iinima iiwinayi. Ihe natu tale tango shoka sha ningilwa David pokati mpono.

Konima sho David a yi Saul ontuku, ye ota holama molumbogo. Aamwayina noshihupe shuukwanezimo we otaye ya wo ya kale moka. Otapu ya konyala aalumentu 400 ayehe kumwe, David nota ningi omuwiliki gwawo. David ota yi nduno komukwaniilwa gwaMoab nota ti: ‘Alikana tate nameme naya kale pungoye sigo ngame tandi mono shoka tandi ningilwa.’ Konima David naalumentu ye otaya tameke okuholama miikulundundu.

Konima yaashika David ota tsakaneke Abigail. Omulumentu gwe Nabal omunahambo omuyamba. Ye oku na oonzi 3 000 niikombo 1 000. Nabal oye omukwanyanya. Ihe omukiintu gwe Abigail omwaanawa noonkondo. Ye oku shi wo okulonga shoka shu uka. Nokuli oshikando shimwe ye ota hupitha uukwanegumbo we. Natu tale kutya ongiini.

David naalumentu ye oya ningile nawa Nabal. Yo oye mu kwathele okugamena oonzi dhe. Esiku limwe David ota tumu yamwe yomaalumentu ye okupula esilohenda kuNabal. Aalumentu yaDavid otaye ya kuNabal omanga ye naakwathi ye taa kulula ko omafufu goonzi. Olyo esiku lyoshituthi, Nabal noku na iinima oyindji iitoye yokuliwa. Ano aalumentu yaDavid otaa ti: ‘Tse otwe ku ningile nawa. Tse inatu yaka po oonzi dhoye, ihe otwe ku kwathele oku dhi tonatela. Alikana tu pa ngashingeyi iikulya.’

‘Ngame itandi gandja iikulya yandje kaalumentu ngaashi ne,’ Nabal ta ti. Ye ota longitha elaka ewinayi notu ula David iinima iiwinayi. Sho aalumentu taa galukile kuDavid notaye mu hokololele kombinga yaashono, David ota geyelele. ‘Ihomatekeni omagongamwele geni!’ ye ta lombwele aalumentu ye. Notaa yi ya ka dhipage Nabal naalumentu ye.

Gumwe gwomaalumentu yaNabal ngoka u uvu iitya yuuwinayi mbyoka Nabal a popi, ota hokololele Abigail shoka sha ningwa po. Abigail ota longekidha mbala iikulya. Ote yi londeke kokasino nota yi. Sho ye ta tsakaneke David, ye ota londoloka ko kokasino ke, ota tsu oongolo nota ti: ‘Alikana tatekulu, ino piyaganekwa komulumentu gwandje Nabal. Ye egoya noha ningi iinima yuugoya. Omagano ogo ngaka. Alikana ga taamba, nou tu dhimine po kwaashono sha ningwa po.’

‘Ngoye omukiintu omunandunge,’ David ta yamukula. ‘Ngoye owa keelele ndje ndaa dhipage Nabal ndi mu shunithile uuwinayi we. Inda ngashingeyi kegumbo nombili.’ Konima, sho Nabal a si, Abigail ota ningi gumwe gwomaakiintu yaDavid. 1 Samuel 22:1-4; 25:1-43.

SAUL ota kambadhala ishewe okukwata David. Ye ota kutha 3 000 yomaakwiita ye aawanawa note ke mu konga. Sho David te shi uvu, ye ota tumu oondaadhi okutala mpoka Saul naalumentu ye yu unga ontanda molwuusiku. Opo nduno David ota pula yaali yomaalumentu ye: ‘Olye gwomune ta ka ya pamwe nangame kontanda yaSaul?’

‘Ongame,’ Abisai ta ti. Abisai omwanamati gwaSeruja, omumwayinakadhona gwaDavid. Manga Saul naalumentu ye ya kotha, David naAbisai otayi iyakele mo montanda. Otaa toola po egonga lyaSaul nombago ye yomeya, ndyoka yi li ontega nomutse gwaSaul. Nando gumwe e ya wete nenge e yu uvite, oshoka ayehe oya kotha ya pwila mo.

Tala ngashingeyi kuDavid naAbisai. Yo oya za mo noye li nombili pombanda yondungu yondundu. David oti ithana elenga lyaakwiita lyaIsrael: ‘Abner, omolwashike itoo gamene omuwa gwoye, omukwaniilwa? Tala! Egonga lye nombago ye yomeya oyi li peni?’

Saul ota penduka. Ye ota dhimbulula ewi lyaDavid nota pula: ‘Ongoye David?’ Mbela ngoye oto vulu okumona Saul naAbner mpeyaka pevi?

‘Eeno, omuwa gwandje omukwaniilwa,’ David ta yamukula. David nota pula: ‘Omolwashike to kambadhala u kwate ndje? Onda longa shike oshiwinayi? Egonga lyoye olyo ndi, omukwaniilwa. Gumwe gwomaalumentu yoye ne li ile.’ ‘Ngame onda yono,’ Saul ta zimine. ‘Ngame onda longo uugoya.’ Opo tuu mpono David ota yi nondjila ye, Saul nota shuna kegumbo. Ihe David oti ipopile: ‘Limwe lyomomasiku Saul ona ka dhipaga ndje. Ondi na okuya ontuku koshilongo shAafilisti.’ Nosho shoka ye ta ningi. David ota sindana mwaashika okufundjaleka Aafilisti note yi itaalitha kutya ye ngashingeyi oku li kombinga yawo.

Konima yokathimbo Aafilisti otaa yi ya ka kondjithe Israel. Molugodhi Saul naJonatan ayehe yaali otaa dhipagwa. Otashi yematitha David noonkondo, nota nyola eimbilo ewanawa moka ye ti imbi: ‘Ngame ondi uvite uuthigwa omolwoye, omumwameme Jonatan. Alikana ngoye owa li omuholike gwandje ngiini!’

Konima yaashino David ota galukile kuIsrael nota kala moshilando shaHebron. Opu na iita pokati kaalumentu mboka taa hogolola omwanamati gwaSaul Ish-Boshet oye a kale omukwaniilwa naalumentu mboka ya hala David oye a kale omukwaniilwa. Ihe lwahugunina aalumentu yaDavid otaa sindana. David oku na oomvula 30 sho ye ta ningi omukwaniilwa. Ye ota pangele uule woomvula heyali netata muHebron. Yamwe yomaamati mboka ye mu valelwa hoka, oyo Amnon, Absalom naAdonia.

Ethimbo olya thikana opo David naalumentu ye ya ka yuge ko oshilando oshiwanawa shedhina Jerusalem. Joab, omwanamati gulwe gwomu-mwayinakadhona gwaDavid Se-ruja, ota kwatele komeho molu-godhi. Ano David ota futu Joab e mu ninge elenga lyaakwiita ye. Ngashingeyi David ota tameke okupangela moshilando shaJerusalem. 1 Samuel 26:1-25; 27:1-7; 31:1-6; 2 Samuel 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; 1 Ondjalulahokololo 11:1-9.

SHO David a tameke okupangela muJerusalem, Jehova ota gandja omasindano ogendji ketanga lye lyaakwiita li sinde aatondi yawo. Jehova okwa li u uvaneke okugandja oshilongo shaKanaan kAaisrael. Nongashingeyi kekwatho lyaJehova, oshitopolwa ashihe shoka sha li she yu uvanekelwa lwahugunina otashi ningi shawo.

David oye omupangeli omwaanawa. Ye oku hole Jehova. Ano shimwe shomiinima mbyoka ye a ningi tango konima sho ye a yugu ko Jerusalem, osho okufala oshiketha shehangano shaJehova hoka. Nokwa hala a tunge otempeli moka tashi vulu okupungulwa.

Sho David a koko, ye ota ningi epuko enene. David oku shi shi kutya osha puka okukutha sha shoka shagumwe i ili. Ihe ongulohi yimwe, omanga ye e li montala yuuwa we, ye ota tala pevi nota mono omukiintu omwaanawa noonkondo. Edhina lye oBatseba, nomulumentu gwe oye gumwe gwomaakwiita ye gwedhina Uria.

David okwa hala Batseba noonkondo opo ye e mu etelwe kuuwa we. Omulumentu gwe oku li kelondo. Ano David ota lala naye nokonima ota mono kutya ye oku li metegelelo. David oti ipula nayi nota lombwele elenga lyaakwiita ye a tule Uria komeho golugodhi mpono ye ta ka dhipagwa. Sho Uria a si, David ota hokana po Batseba.

Jehova okwa geyela David noonkondo. Ano ota tumu omupiya gwe Natan oku ke mu hokololela omayono ge. Ngoye oto vulu okumona nkene Natan ta popi mpaka naDavid. David oku uvite nayi noonkondo kwaashono a ningi, nomolwashoka Jehova ite mu dhipaga. Ihe Jehova ota ti: ‘Molwashoka ngoye owa ningi iinima mbika iiwinayi, ngoye oto ka mona uudhigu owindji megumbo lyoye.’ Alikana uudhigu ou thike peni David ta kala e na!

Tango omwanamati gwaBatseba ota si. Opo nduno omwanamati omutango Amnon ota kala oye awike nomumwayinakadhona Tamar, note mu thiminike oku mu hola. Omwanamati gwaDavid Absalom okwa geya ngaaka kwaashino kutya ye a dhipage Amnon. Konima Absalom ota ningitha oyendji yomoshigwana ye mu hokwe noti iningi ye mwene omukwaniilwa. Lwahugunina David ota sindi iita yawo naAbsalom, ngoka ta dhipagwa. Eeno, David oku na uudhigu owindji.

Pokati mpono Batseba ota mono okamati kedhina Salomo. Sho David a kulupa note ehama, omwanamati Adonia ota kambadhala okwiininga ye mwene omukwaniiilwa. Opo tuu mpoka David ota gwayekitha omusaaseri Sadok omugwayo momutse gwaSalomo okuulika kutya Salomo ota ka kala omukwaniilwa. Konima yokathimbo David okwa si muukokele woomvula 70. Ye okwa pangele uule woomvula 40, ihe ngashingeyi Salomo oye omu-kwaniilwa gwaIsrael. 2 Samuel 11:1-27; 12:1-18; 1 Aakwaniilwa 1:1-48.

SALOMO sho a ningi omukwaniilwa ye oku li omugundjuka. Ye oku hole Jehova, noha pulakene kepukululo ewanawa ndyoka he David a li e mu pe. Jehova okwa hokwa Salomo, nuusiku wumwe ano ye ota ti kuye mondjodhi: ‘Salomo, owa hala ndi ku pe shike?’

Kwaashino Salomo ota yamukula: ‘Jehova Kalunga kandje, ngame omugundjuka nokandi shi okupangela. Pe ndje omayele okupangela oshigwana shoye pamukalo omwaanawa.’

Jehova okwa nyanyukwa keindilo lyaSalomo. Ano Ye ota ti: ‘Molwashoka ngoye owa pula omayele, hamwenyo omule nenge uuyamba, otandi ku pe omayele ogendji ge vule gagumwe ngoka inaa kala ko nale. Ihe ngame otandi ku pe wo shoka ngoye inoo shi pula, eliko nesimano.’

Konima yokathimbo aakiintu yaali otaye ya kuSalomo nuupyakadhi uunene. ‘Ngame nomukiintu nguka otwa kala megumbo limwe,’ gumwe gwomuyo ta yelitha. ‘Ngame onda mono okamati nokonima yomasiku gaali naye wo okwa mono okamati. Ihe uusiku wumwe okanona ke oka si. Manga ngame nda kotha, ye okwa langeke okanona hoka ka sa ponto yandje nokwa kutha po kandje. Sho ngame nda penduka e tandi tala kokanona hoka ka sa, ngame onda mono kutya kake shi kandje.’

Opo nduno omukiintu gulwe ota ti: ‘Aawe! Okanona hoka okanamwenyo okandje, naahoka ka sa oke!’ Omukiintu gwotango ota yamukula: ‘Aawe! Okanona hoka ka sa okoye, naahoka okanamwenyo okandje!’ Osho aakiintu yaali taa ludhike. Salomo ota ka ninga po nee shike?

Ota ka talitha egongamwele nota ti nduno: ‘Teta okanona okanamwenyo pokati nou pe omukiintu kehe etata lyako.’ ‘Aawe!’ yina gwolela ti igidha. ‘Alikana okanona inamu ka dhipaga. Ke mu peni!’ Ihe omukiintu gulwe ota ti: ‘Kake na okupewa gumwe gwomutse; ka teteni pokati.’

Lwahugunina Salomo ota popi: ‘Inamu dhipaga okanona! Ka gandjeni komukiintu gwotango. Oye yina gwolela.’ Salomo oku shi shi, oshoka yina gwolela oku hole okanona unene sho a hala ka gandjwe komukiintu gulwe opo kaaka dhipagwe. Sho oshigwana tashi uvu nkene Salomo a kandula po uupyakadhi mbuka, sho otashi nyanyukwa okukala shi na omukwaniilwa omunamayele ngawo.

Pethimbo lyelelo lyaSalomo Kalunga ota laleke oshigwana nuuyamba mokweetitha evi iilya oyindji, omandjembele noonkwiyu niikulya yilwe. Aantu oya zala oonguwo oombwanawa noye li momagumbo omawanawa. Opu na iinima ya gwanenena iiwanawa kwaayehe. 1 Aakwaniilwa 3:3-28; 5:9-14 (4:29-34, OB-1986).

MANGA David inaa sa, ye okwa gandja omusindaulikilo gwetungo lyotempeli yaJehova kuSalomo, ngoka ye a pewa kuKalunga. Momumvo omutine gwelelo lye Salomo ota tameke okutunga otempeli, notashi pula oomvula heyali netata oku yi mana. Aalumentu omayuvi omilongo otaa longo potempeli, netu-ngo otali kotha okandumba kiimaliwa oyindji. Osho mo-lwashono tapu longithwa oshingoli noshisiliveli oshindji molwayo.

Otempeli oyi na omala gaali omanene, ngaashi naa-naa etsalihangano lya li. Ihe omala ngaka oma-nene ngawo lwiikando iyali ge vulithe ngoka gometsalihangano. Salomo ota tulitha mo oshiketha shehangano meni mo mwene lyela lyotempeli, niinima yimwe mbyoka ya pungulwa meni lyetsalihangano, otayi tulwa mela lilwe.

Sho otempeli tayi pu, otapu ningwa oshituthi oshinene. Salomo ota tsu oongolo komeho gotempeli nota galikana, ngaashi ngoye to vulu okumona mefano. ‘Nokuli egulu alihe itali ku gwanene,’ Salomo ta ti kuJehova, ‘ano otempeli ndjika oyi ku gwanene ngiini? Ihe Kalunga kandje, pulakena alikana koshigwana shoye uuna tashi galikana sha taalela kehala ndika.’

Sho Salomo ta hulitha egalikano lye, omulilo otagu zi megulu. Otagu fike po omayambo giinamwenyo ngoka ge etwa. Nuuyelele tau adhima wa zi kuJehova tau udha otempeli. Otashi holola kutya Jehova ota pulakene nonokutya otempeli negalikano lyaSalomo okwe yi hokwa. Ngashingeyi otempeli oyo ehala hoka aantu haa yi oku ka galikana pehala lyetsalihangano. Salomo ota pangele ethimbo ele noondunge, naantu oyu uvite elago. Ihe Salomo ota hokana naakiintu oyendji yokiilongo yilwe mboka ihaaya galikana Jehova. Oto vulu mbela okumona nkene gumwe gwomuyo ta galikana oshikalunga? Lwahugunina aakiintu yaSalomo otaye mu ningitha wo a galikane iikalunga. Owa tseya mbela shoka tashi ningwa po uuna Salomo te shi ningi? Ye ita ningile we aantu nawa. Ye ota ningi omugeentu, naantu kaye uvite we elago.

Shika otashi geyithitha Salomo kuJehova, ye ota ti kuye: ‘Ngame otandi ke ku yuga uukwaniilwa notandi wu pe omulumentu gulwe. Itandi ke shi ninga pethimbo lyonkalamwenyo yoye, ihe opethimbo lyelelo lyo-mumwoye. Ihe itandi ka kutha po aantu ayehe yuukwaniilwa womumwo-ye.’ Natu tale nkene tashi ningwa. 1 Ondjalulahokololo 28:9-21; 29:1-9; 1 Aakwaniilwa 5:15-32 (5:1-18, OB-1986); 2 Ondjalulahokololo 6:12-42; 7:1-5; 1 Aakwaniilwa 11:9-13.

OWA tseya tuu kutya omolwashike omulumentu nguka ta tuulagula onguwo ye? Jehova oye e mu lombwele e shi ninge. Omulumentu nguka oye omuprofeti gwaKalunga Ahia. Owa tseya ndishi kutya omuprofeti oshike? Oye omuntu ngoka Kalunga ha lombwele shoka tashi ka ningwa komeho.

Mpaka Ahia ota popi naJerobeam. Jerobeam omulumentu ngoka a tulwa po kuSalomo okutonatela oshitopolwa shiilonga ye yetungo. Sho Ahia ta tsakaneke Jerobeam mpaka mondjila, Ahia ota longo shoka inaashi monika nale. Ye ota hula mo onguwo ye ompe note yi tuula oontopola 12. Ye ota ti kuJerobeam: ‘Ikuthila po oontopola 10.’ Owa tseya kutya omolwashike Ahia ta pe Jerobeam oontopola 10?

Ahia ota yelitha kutya Jehova uukwaniilwa ote ke wu yuga ko kuSalomo. Ye ota ti kutya Jehova ota ka gandja omazimo 10 kuJerobeam. Otashi ti kutya omazimo gaali ageke taga ka hupa po ngono omwana gwaSalomo Rehabeam ta vulu okupangela.

Sho Salomo tu uvu shoka Ahia a ti kuJerobeam, ye ota geye noonkondo. Ye ota kambadhala okudhipaga Jerobeam. Ihe Jerobeam ota yi ontuku kuEgipiti. Konima yethimbo Salomo okwa si. Ye okwa kala omukwaniilwa uule woomvula 40, ihe ngashingeyi omwana Rehabeam ota ningi omukwaniilwa. MuEgipiti Jerobeam otu uvu kutya Salomo okwa sa, nota galukile ihe kuIsrael.

Rehabeam ke shi omukwaniilwa omwaanawa. Nokuli ye ota ningi oshigwana nayi unene shi vulithe shoka he Salomo e shi ningile. Jerobeam naalumentu yalwe ya simana otaa yi kOmukwaniilwa Rehabeam notaye mu indile a ningile aantu nawa. Ihe Rehabeam ita pulakene. Paushili wo wene, ye nokuli ota ningi omukwanyanya shi vulithe nale. Ano aantu otaa ningi Jerobeam oye omukwaniilwa gwomazimo 10, ihe omazimo gaali Benjamin naJuda otaga ambidhidha Rehabeam oye omukwaniilwa gwawo.

Jerobeam ina hala aalelwa ye ya ye kuJerusalem ya ka galikane motempeli yaJehova. Ano ye ota ningi oontana dhoshingoli mbali nota ningitha aantu yuukwaniilwa womazimo 10 ye dhi galikane. Mbala oshilongo oshu udha iilonga yomuyonena nekuni.

Omu na wo uupyakadhi muukwaniilwa womazimo gaali. Konima yoomvula dhi vulike kuntano sho Rehabeam a ningi omukwaniilwa, omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti ote ya a kondjithe Jerusalem. Ye ota kutha omaliko ogendji motempeli yaJehova e ta shuna pamwe nago. Ano otempeli oya kala owala uule wokathimbo naanaa ngaashi ya li sho ya tungwa. 1 Aakwaniilwa 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31.

KONIMA yeso lyOmukwaniilwa Jerobeam, aakwaniilwa ayehe yuukwaniilwa waIsrael womazimo 10 gokuumbangalantu oya kala aawinayi. Omukwaniilwa Ahab oye omukwaniilwa omwiinayi a shiga ko kwaayehe. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike? Etompelo limwe enene olyo omukiintu gwe, Omukwaniilwakiintu omuwiinayi Isebel.

Isebel ke shi Omwiisrael. Ye omwanakadhona gwomukwaniilwa gwaSidon. Ye oha galikana oshikalunga Baal, nota ningitha Ahab nAaisrael oyendji ya galikane wo Baal. Isebel oku tonde Jehova noha dhipagitha oyendji yomaaprofeti ye. Yamwe oye na okuholama momalumbogo opo yaa dhipagwe. Ngele Isebel a hala sha, oha dhipaga omuntu nokuli opo e shi mone.

Esiku limwe Omukwaniilwa Ahab ota ningi omwenyo omwiinayi noonkondo. Ano Isebel ote mu pula: ‘Omolwashike wa ninga omwenyo omwiinayi ngawo nena?’

‘Omolwoshinima shoka Nabot a lombwele ndje,’ Ahab ta yamukula. ‘Ngame onda li nda hala okulanda po oshilonda she shomiviinu. Ihe ye okwa tindi.’

‘Ngoye ku na okunika uuthigwa,’ Isebel ta ti. ‘Ngame otandi ke shi ku monena.’

Isebel ota nyolele aalumentu ya simana yomoshilando ombilive moka omulumentu nguka Nabot a kala. ‘Moneni aakolokoshi yontumba ya tye kutya Nabot okwa tuka Kalunga nomukwaniilwa,’ ye ta ti kuyo. ‘Kutheni mo nduno Nabot moshilando nomu mu dhipage nomamanya.’

Sho Isebel tu uvu kutya Nabot okwa sa, ye ota lombwele Ahab: ‘Inda u ki ikuthile po oshilonda she shomiviinu.’ Ito dhiladhila wo mbela kutya Isebel oku na okugeyelwa molwashoka ye okwa longo oshinima oshitilithi ngawo?

Omolwashoka Jehova konima ta tumu omulumentu Jehu oku mu geyela. Sho Isebel tu uvu kutya Jehu ote ya, ye oti igwayeke kombanda yomeho ge nota kambadhala okwiiyopaleka. Ihe uuna Jehu te ya nota monene Isebel mekende, ye oti igidha aalumentu yomuuwa: ‘Mu umbileni pevi!’ Aalumentu otaa vulika kuye, ngaashi to vulu oku shi mona mefano. Yo otaye mu umbile pevi, nota si. Olyo ehulilo lyOmukwaniilwakiintu omuwiinayi Isebel. 1 Aakwaniilwa 16:29-33; 18:1-4; 21:1-16; 2 Aakwaniilwa 9:30-37.

OWA tseya kutya aalumentu mbano oolye notaa ningi shike? Yo otaa yi ya ka kondje, naalumentu komehoelela otayi imbi. Ngiika ngoye oto pula: ‘Omolwashike aaimbi kaaye na omagongamwele nomagonga gokukondjitha?’ Natu tale.

Josafat oye omukwaniilwa guukwaniilwa waIsrael womazimo gaali. Ye okwa kala nomwenyo pethimbo lyOmukwaniilwa Ahab naIsebel yuukwaniilwa womazimo 10 gokuumbangalantu. Ihe Josafat oye omukwaniilwa omwaanawa, nahe Asa okwa li wo omukwaniilwa omwaanawa. Ano uule woomvula odhindji aantu yuukwaniilwa womazimo gaali gokuumbugantu otaa nyanyukilwa onkalamwenyo ombwanawa.

Ihe ngashingeyi otapu ningwa sha shoka tashi mbandameke aantu. Aatumwa otaa ti kuJosafat: ‘Etanga lyaakwiita enene lyokiilongo yaMoab, yaAmoni naamboka yokOndundu yaSeir otaye ya oku ku ponokela.’ Aaisrael oyendji otaa gongala kuJerusalem okupula ekwatho kuJehova. Yo otaa yi kotempeli, naahoka Josafat ota galikana: ‘Akutu, Jehova Kalunga ketu, tse katu shi wo shoka tu na okuninga. Tse katu na ekwatho lyasha komeho yetanga lyaakwiita ndika enene. Tse otatu kongo ekwatho kungoye.’

Jehova ota pulakene note etha gumwe gwomaapiya ye a tye koshigwana: ‘Olugodhi kalu shi lweni, ihe olwaKalunga. Ne itamu ka pumbwa okukondja. Taleni owala, nomu mone nkene Jehova te mu hupitha.’

Ongula ya landula Josafat ota ti koshigwana: ‘Inekeleni Jehova!’ Opo nduno ote etha aaimbi ye ende komeho yaakwiita ye, nomanga taye ende, yo otayi imbile Jehova omaimbilo gehambelelo. Owa tseya kutya oshike tashi ningwa po uuna taye ya popepi nelondo? Jehova ote etha aakwiita aatondi ya kondjithathane. Nuuna Aaisrael taa thiki po, aakwiita ayehe aatondi otaya adhika ya sa!

Josafat okwa li noondunge okwiinekela Jehova, hasho mbela? Tse otatu ka kala wo aanandunge ngele tatu Mu inekele. 1 Aakwaniilwa 22:41-53; 2 Ondjalulahokololo 20:1-30.

NATU tye nee ngoye owa sa. Meme gwoye ota ka kala e uvite ngiini mbela ngele to yumuka? Ye ota ka kala a nyanyukwa noonkondo! Ihe mbela omuntu ngoka a sa ota vulu ngaa okuninga ishewe omwenyo? Mbela osha ningwa ngaa nale?

Tala mpaka komulumentu, nomukiintu nokamati. Omulumentu oye omuprofeti Elia. Omukiintu oye omuselekadhi gwokoshilando Sarepta, nomumati okanona ke. Esiku limwe omumati ote ehama. Ote ehama nokweehama sigo ta si. Elia ota ti nduno komukiintu: ‘Eta omumati kungame.’

Elia ota humbata okanona okasi te ende kiilyatelo note ka langeke kontala. Ta galikana nduno: ‘Akutu Jehova, omumati mu ninga ishewe omunamwenyo.’ Nomumati ota tameke ta fudha! Opo tuu mpoka Elia ote mu fala ishewe pevi nota ti komukiintu: ‘Tala, omumati gwoye oku na omwenyo!’ Osho molwashono yina a nyanyukwa ngawo.

Natango omuprofeti a simana gwaKalunga oElisa. Ye omukwathi gwaElia. Ihe konima Jehova ota longitha wo Elisa okulonga iikumithalonga. Esiku limwe Elisa ota yi koshilando shaSunem hoka ku na omukiintu e li nawa naye. Konima omukiintu nguka ota mono okamati.

Ongula yimwe, sho okanona ka koko, otaka yi kuhe ngoka ta longo mepya. Ombadhilila omumati oti igidha: ‘Omutse gwandje otagu ehama!’ Sho ye a falwa kegumbo, omumati okwa si. Alikana yina okwa sa oluhodhi ngiini! Ye ota ka tala mbalambala Elisa.

Sho Elisa te ya, ye ota yi kondunda hoka okanona okasi ka lala. Ye ota galikana kuJehova nota lala pomudhimba. Mbala olutu lwomumati otalu pupyala nota shemita lwiikando iheyali. Alikana yina okwa nyanyukwa ngiini sho te ya mo nota mono omwana e na omwenyo!

Aantu oyendji ya nyenge okuyalulwa oya si nale. Osha nikitha aakwanegumbo nookuume kawo oluhodhi olunene. Tse katu na oonkondo okuyumudha aasi. Ihe Jehova oku na. Konima otatu ki ilonga nkene ye ta ka yumudha aantu omamiliyona. 1 Aakwaniilwa 17:8-24; 2 Aakwaniilwa 4:8-37.

OWA tseya kutya okakadhona haka otaka ti shike? Otaka hokololele omukiintu kombinga yomuprofeti gwaJehova Elisa niinima iikumithalonga mbyoka Jehova e mu kwatha oku yi longa. Omukiintu ina tseya Jehova, oshoka ye ke shi Omwiisrael. Natu tale kutya molwashike nduno okakadhona ke li megumbo lyomukiintu.

Omukiintu Omwaarami. Omulumentu gwe oNaeman, elenga lyiita yaAram. Aayarami oya kwata okakadhona haka okaIsrael nongashingeyi ko okalongeli komukiintu gwaNaeman.

Naeman oku na uuvu uutilithi, hau ithanwa onziya. Nokuli ohau vulu okugwitha ko iintimbu yoontumba dholutu lwomuntu. Ano okakadhona otaka lombwele omukiintu gwaNaeman: ‘Ngame onda hala omuwa gwandje a vule okuya komuprofeti gwaJehova kuIsrael. Ye ota ka panga onziya ye.’ Konima omukiintu ota lombwele omulumentu gwe shoka okakadhona ka ti.

Naeman okwa hala noonkondo okwaaluka; ano ye ota tokola a ye kuIsrael. Sho ye ta thiki hono, ota yi kegumbo lyaElisa. Elisa ota tumu omupiya gwe okulombwela Naeman kutya ne ki iyoge luheyali mOmulonga gwaJordan. Otashi geyitha Naeman noonkondo, nota ti: ‘Omilonga dhokegumbo omiwanawa dhi vulithe omulonga kehe muIsrael!’ Sho te shi ti, Naeman ota yi.

Ihe gumwe gwomaapiya ye ota ti kuye: ‘Tatekulu, andola Elisa okwe ku lombwelele sha oshidhigu u shi ninge, andola owe shi ningi owala. Omolwashike ngoye itoo vulu okwiiyoga owala ngaashi ye a ti?’ Naeman ota pulakene komupiya gwe nota yi e ki iyoge lwiikando iheyali mOmulonga gwaJordan. Sho te shi ningi, olutu lwe otalu aluka!

Naeman okwa nyanyukwa noonkondo. Ye ota galukile kuElisa nota ti kuye: ‘Ngashingeyi ondi shi shi nawa kutya Kalunga komuIsrael oye awike Kalunga kashili kevi alihe. Alikana taamba ko omagano gandje ngaka.’ Ihe Elisa ota yamukula: ‘Aawe, ngame itandi ga taamba ko.’ Elisa oku shi shi kutya otashi ka kala sha puka okutaamba ko omagano, oshoka okwa li oJehova ngoka a aludha Naeman. Ihe omupiya gwaElisa Gehasi okwa hala omagano ga ninge po ge.

Osho shoka Gehasi ta ningi: Sho Naeman a yi, Gehasi ota matuka e mu landula. ‘Elisa okwa tumu ndje ndi ku lombwele kutya ye okwa hala lela gamwe gomomagano goye molwookuume ke mboka ye ya ngashingeyi ye mu talele po,’ Gehasi ta ti. Osho iifundja iitokele. Ihe Naeman ke shi shi ngele osho iifundja; ano ye ota gandja yimwe yomiinima kuGehasi.

Sho Gehasi te ya pegumbo, Elisa oku shi shi shoka ye a ningi. Jehova okwe mu lombwele. Omolwashoka ye ta ti: ‘Molwashono ngoye owa longo iinima mbino iiwinayi, ngoye oto ka mona uuvu wonziya waNaeman.’ Nokwe wu mono owala mbalambala!

Oshike tse tatu vulu okwiilonga muka? Shotango, osho kutya tse otu na okukala ngaashi okakadhona nokupopya kombinga yaJehova. Otashi vulu okukwatha aantu noonkondo. Oshitiyali, tse katu na okukala nuuntsa ngaashi Naeman a li tango, ihe tse otu na okuvulika kaapiya yaKalunga. Noshititatu, tse katu na okupopya iifundja ngaashi Gehasi. Tse otatu vulu okwiilonga oshindji uuna tse tatu lesha Ombimbeli, hasho mbela? 2 Aakwaniilwa 5:1-27.

TALA komulumentu ngoka e li momeya. Ye oku li muudhigu uunene, hasho mbela? Ohi ndjoka otayi ke mu nina po! Owa tseya kutya omulumentu nguka olye? Edhina lye oJona. Natu tale nkene ye e ya muudhigu u thike mpono.

Jona oye omuprofeti gwaJehova. Okathimbo konima yeso lyaElisa Jehova ota lombwele Jona: ‘Inda koshilando oshinene Ninive. Aantu yaahoka oyo aawinayi noonkondo, ngame nonda hala ngoye u ka popye nayo kombinga yaashono.’

Ihe Jona ina hala a ye ko. Ano ye ota londo mosikepa ndjoka itaayi yi kuNinive, ihe okombinga haayo. Jehova ina nyanyukwa sho Jona ta fadhuka po. Ano Ye ote eta oshikungulu oshinene. Oshidhigu ngaaka kutya osikepa yi kale moshiponga shokuningina. Aanasikepa oya tila noonkondo notayi ithana ekwatho kiikalunga yawo. Lwahugunina Jona ota ti kuyo: ‘Ngame ohandi galikana Jehova, Kalunga ngoka a shiti egulu nevi. Notandi yi ontuku shoka Jehova a lombwele ndje ndi shi ninge.’ Aanasikepa otaa pula: ‘Tse otu na oku ku ninga ngiini opo oshikungulu shi lote?’

‘Umbilii ndje mefuta nefuta otali mwena ishewe,’ Jona ta ti. Aanasikepa inaya hala oku shi ninga, ihe sho oshikungulu tashi pindjala, lwahugunina yo otayu umbile Jona mefuta. Oshikungulu otashi loto mbala nefuta otali mwena ishewe.

Sho Jona ta thiki momeya, ohi onene otayi mu nina po. Ihe ye ina sa. Omitenya ndatu nomausiku gatatu ye e li mela lyohi ndjoka. Jona oku uvite nayi noonkondo sho ye inaa vulika kuJehova noinaa ya kuNinive. Owa tseya kutya ye ota ningi po shike?

Jona ota galikana ekwatho kuJehova. Opo nduno Jehova ota ningitha ohi yi kungile Jona kevi ekukutu. Konima yaashoka Jona ota yi kuNinive. Otashi tu longo nkene sha simana okuninga shoka Jehova ta ti, hasho mbela? Embombimbeli lyaJona.

OSHO efano lyoparadisa ngaashi Kalunga tashi vulika e yi ulukile omuprofeti gwe Jesaja. Jesaja okwa kala nomwenyo okathimbo okafupi konima yeso lyaJona.

Oparadisa otashi ti “oshikunino” nenge “oparka.” Itashi ku dhimbulukitha nando mbela kusha shoka tse twe shi mono nale membo ndika? Otashi monika sha fa oshikunino oshiwanawa shoka Jehova Kalunga a ningilile Adam naEva, hasho mbela? Ihe evi alihe otali vulu ngaa mbela oku ka kala oparadisa?

Jehova okwa lombwele omuprofeti gwe Jesaja a nyolele oshigwana shaKalunga kombinga yoparadisa ompe ndjoka tayi ke ya. Ye okwa ti: ‘Omambungu noonzi otadhi ka kala pamwe nombili. Oontana noonime oongundjuka otadhi ka napela pamwe, naanona aashona otaye ke dhi litha. Nokuli nando okanona okashona otaka ka dhana popepi neyoka lyuuzigo, ko itaka ka komonwa.’

‘Shika itashi vulu okuningwa nando,’ ngiika oyendji osho taa ti. ‘Uudhigu opo wa kala nale kombanda yevi, nopo tau ka kala aluhe.’ Ihe dhiladhila kwaashino: Ehala lyokukala lya tya ngiini Kalunga a pe Adam naEva?

Kalunga okwa tula Adam naEva moparadisa. Yo oya kanitha owala ehala lyawo lyokukala, ya kulupa noya si molwashono yo ya li inaaya vulika kuKalunga. Kalunga otu uvaneke a pe aantu mboka ye mu hole iinima naanaa mbyoka Adam naEva ya kanitha.

Moparadisa ompe ndjoka tayi ya itamu ka kala shoka tashi ehameke aantu nenge shoka tashi eta uuwinayi. Otamu ka kala ombili ya gwanenena. Ayehe otaa ka kala nuukolele nonelago. Otashi ka kala naanaa ngaashi Kalunga e shi halele petameko. Ihe otatu ki ilonga nale nkene Kalunga te ke shi ninga. Jesaja 11:6-9; Ehololo 21:3, 4.

OWA tseya kutya omolwashike omulumentu nguka ta galikana kuJehova? Omolwashike ye a tenteka oombilive ndhino komeho goaltari yaJehova? Omulumentu oye Hiskia. Ye omukwaniilwa gwomazimo gaali gaIsrael gokuumbugantu. Noku li muudhigu uunene. Omolwashike?

Oshoka omatanga gaakwiita gaAssur oga hanagula po nale omazimo 10 gokuumbangalantu. Jehova oye a pitika shi ningwe molwashoka aantu mboka oya li aawinayi ngaaka. Nongashingeyi omatanga gaakwiita gaAssur otage ya okukondjitha uukwaniilwa womazimo gaali.

Omukwaniilwa gwaAssur opo a tumu oombilive dha tya ngawo kOmukwaniilwa Hiskia. Odho oombilive ndhoka Hiskia a tula mpaka koshipala shaKalunga. Oombilive otadhi sheke Jehova, notadhi lombwele Hiskia i igandje. Osho molwashono Hiskia ta galikana: ‘Akutu Jehova, tu hupitha komukwaniilwa gwaAssur. Opo nduno iigwana ayihe tayi ka tseya kutya ongoye awike Kalunga.’ Jehova ota ka pulakena ngaa mbela kuHiskia?

Hiskia oye omukwaniilwa omwaanawa. Ye ina fa aakwaniilwa aawinayi yuukwaniilwa waIsrael womazimo 10, nenge ngaashi he omwiinayi, Omukwaniilwa Ahas. Hiskia okwa longo naanaa ngaashi tashi vulika okuvulika koompango dhaJehova adhihe. Sho Hiskia a mana okugalikana, ano omuprofeti Jesaja ota tumine kuye etumwalaka lyaJehova ndika: ‘Omukwaniilwa gwaAssur ite ke ya mo muJerusalem. Nokuli hagumwe gwomaakwiita ye ta ka hedha popepi nasho. Yo itaa ka umba nando osho oshikuti shimwe moshilando.’ Tala kefano pepandja ndika. Owa tseya kutya aakwiita ayehe mbano ya sa oyo oolye? Oyo Aayassur. Jehova okwa tumu omuyengeli gwe, nomuusiku wumwe omuyengeli okwa dhipaga aakwiita Aayassur 185 000. Ano omukwaniilwa gwaAssur oti igandja kolugodhi nota shuna kegumbo.

Uukwaniilwa womazimo gaali owa hupithwa, naantu oya kala uule wethimbo nombili. Ihe konima sho Hiskia a si, omwana Manasse ota ningi omukwaniilwa. Manasse nomwana Amon konima ye ayehe yaali oyo aakwaniilwa aawinayi noonkondo. Ano oshilongo otashi udhithwa ishewe niilonga yomuyonena nekuni. Sho Omukwaniilwa Amon a dhipagwa kaapiya ye, omwana Josia ota ningi omukwaniilwa guukwaniilwa womazimo gaali. 2 Aakwaniilwa 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25.

JOSIA oku na owala oomvula hetatu sho ye ta ningi omukwaniilwa gwomazimo gaali gaIsrael gokuumbanga-lantu. Odho oonshona unene kugumwe a kale omukwa-niilwa. Ano aantu yamwe mboka aakuluntu kuye otaye mu kwatha petameko kombinga yokulela oshigwana.

Sho Josia a kala uule woomvula heyali omukwanii-lwa, ye ota tameke okukonga Jehova. Ye ota landula oshi-holelwa shaakwaniilwa aawa-nawa ngaashi David, Josafat naHiskia. Omanga ye natango e li omugundjuka, Josia ota longo oshinima shuupenda.

Uule wethimbo ele oyendji yomAaisrael oye li aawinayi noonkondo. Yo ohaa galikana iikalunga. Yo ohayi isizimikile iimenka. Omolwashono Josia naalumentu ye taa zi mo notaa tameke okuhanagula po egalikaneno lyiifundja moshilongo. Osho iilonga iidhigu, oshoka aantu oyendji ngaaka mboka haya galikana iikalunga. Ngoye oto vulu okumona Josia naalumentu ye mpaka nkene taa tetagula po iimenka.

Konima Josia ota tula po aalumentu yatatu okutonatela etungululo lyotempeli yaJehova. Iimaliwa otayi pulwa moshigwana notayi pewa aalumentu mbaka okufuta iilonga. Manga yo taa longo motempeli, omusaaseri omukuluntu Hilkia ota mono sha sha simana noonkondo moka. Osho oraamata yoompango ndjoka Jehova a nyolithitha Moses nalenale. Oya li ya kana uule woomvula odhindji.

Oraamata otayi falwa kuJosia noti indile opo e yi leshelwe. Manga ta pulakene, Josia ota ndhindhilike kutya oshigwana inashi dhiginina oompango dhaJehova. Ye okwa yemata kwaashono, ano ye ota tuula oonguwo dhe ngaashi ngoye to vulu okumona mpaka. Ye ota ti: ‘Jehova okwe tu geela, oshoka ookuku yetu inaa dhiginina oompango dhomoraamata ndjika.’ Josia ota lombwele omusaaseri omukuluntu Hilkia a mone kutya Jehova ote ke ya ningila shike. Hilkia ota yi komukiintu Hulda, ngoka omuprofeti, note mu pula. Ye ote mu pe etumwalaka ndika lya zi kuJehova e li fale kuJosia: ‘Jerusalem noshigwana ashihe otaya ka geelwa molwashoka yo oya galikana iikalunga noyu udhitha oshilongo uuwinayi. Ihe molwashoka ngoye, Josia, oto longo shoka oshiwanawa, egeelo ndika itali ke ya manga ngoye inoo sa.’ 2 Ondjalulahokololo 34:1-28.

TALA nkene aantu taa sheke omulumentu nguka omugundjuka. Owa tseya kutya oye lye? Oye Jeremia. Oye omuprofeti gwaKalunga a simana noonkondo.

Mbala konima sho Omukwaniilwa Josia ta tameke ta hanagula po iimenka moshilongo, Jehova ota lombwele Jeremia a kale omuprofeti Gwe. Ihe Jeremia ota dhiladhila kutya ye omushona unene okukala omuprofeti. Ihe Jehova ota ti kutya Ye ote ke mu kwatha.

Jeremia ota lombwele Aaisrael ye ethe po okulonga uuwinayi. ‘Iikalunga mbyoka iigwana hayi galikana, oyo yiifundja,’ ye ta ti. Ihe Aaisrael oyendji oya hala owala ya galikane iikalunga pehala lyokugalikana Kalunga kashili Jehova. Sho Jeremia ta lombwele oshigwana kutya Kalunga ote ke shi geela molwuuwinayi washo, sho otashi mu yolo owala.

Oomvula otadhi piti po. Josia okwa si, nokonima yoomwedhi ndatu omwana Joakim ota ningi omukwaniilwa. Natango Jeremia ota lombwele oshigwana: ‘Jerusalem otashi ka hanagulwa po ngele ne itamu lundulula oondjila dheni oombwinayi.’ Aasaaseri otaa kwata Jeremia notayi igidha: ‘Ngoye ou na okudhipagwa molwiinima mbyoka to popi.’ Opo nduno taya lombwele aapangeli yaIsrael: ‘Jeremia oku na okudhipagwa, oshoka ota popi a tsa ondumbo noshilando shetu.’

Ngashingeyi Jeremia ota ka ninga nee shike? Ye iha tila! Ye ota ti kuyo: ‘Jehova oye a tumu ndje ndi mu lombwele iinima mbika. Ngele ne itamu lundulula omikalo dhonkalamwenyo yeni ombwinayi, Jehova ota ka hanagula po Jerusalem. Mwaashika ne otamu vulu okukala nuushili: Ngele otamu dhipaga ndje, ne otamu dhipaga omulumentu kee na oondjo.’

Aapangeli otaa pitika Jeremia a kale nomwenyo, ihe Aaisrael itaa lundulula omikalo dhawo omiwinayi. Konima Nebukadnesar, omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, ote ya okukondjitha Jerusalem. Lwahugunina Nebukadnesar ota ningi Aaisrael aapiya ye. Ye ota fala omayuvi ogendji kuBabilon. Dhiladhila owala nkene tashi ka kala ngele aantu waahe ya shi taye ku kutha megumbo lyoye e taye ku fala koshilongo waa shi ko nale! Jeremia 1:1-8; 10:1-5; 26:1-16; 2 Aakwaniilwa 24:1-17.

OMUKWANIILWA Nebukadnesar ota fala aalongwantu ayehe Aaisrael kuBabilon. Konima omukwaniilwa ota hogolola mokati kawo aalumentu aagundjuka mboka ye na ondjelo ombwanawa noya kotoka lela. Yane yomuyo oyo aamati mboka ngoye u wete mpaka. Gumwe oDaniel, nayalwe yatatu oya lukwa kAababilon Sadrak, Meshak naAbednego.

Nebukadnesar okwa hala aalumentu aagundjuka e ya longe okulonga muuwa we. Konima yelongo lyoomvula ndatu ye ota ka hogolola mo owala mboka ya kotoka lela oku mu kwatha okukandula po omaupyakadhi ge. Omukwaniilwa okwa hala aamati ya kale ye na oonkondo nuukolele omanga yo taa longwa. Ano ye ota lombwele aapiya ye ya gandje kuyo ayehe iikulya iiwanawa nomaviinu ya faathana naambyoka ye nuu-kwanegumbo we haa pewa.

Tala komugundjuka Daniel. Owa tseya mbela shoka ye ta lombwele omukalele omukuluntu gwaNebukadnesar, Aspena? Daniel ote mu lombwele kutya ye ina hala okulya iikulya iiwanawa yokoshililo shomukwaniilwa. Ihe Aspena oti ipula nayi. ‘Omukwaniilwa ndishi oye a tokola shoka ne mu na okulya nokunwa,’ ye ta ti. ‘Nongele ne omwa kala mwaa na uukolele ngaashi aalumentu yalwe aagundjuka ye li, ye sikulimwe ota ka dhipaga ndje.’

Ano Daniel ota yi komukalele ngoka a tulwa po kuAspena okutonatela Daniel nayakwawo yatatu. ‘Alikana tu yelekela uule womasiku 10,’ ye ta ti. ‘Tu pa iikwamboga okulya nomeya gokunwa. Tu faathanitha nduno naalumentu yalwe aagundjuka mboka taa li iikulya yomukwaniilwa, nou tale kutya oolye taa monika nawa.’

Omukalele ota zimine oku shi ninga. Nokonima yomasiku 10 Daniel nookuume ke yatatu otaa monika ye na uukolele ye vulithe aalumentu ayehe yalwe aagundjuka. Ano omukalele ota pitika ya tsikile nokulya iikwamboga pehala lyaashono omukwaniilwa ta gandja.

Kehulilo lyoomvula ndatu aalumentu ayehe aagundjuka otaa falwa kuNebukadnesar. Sho ye a popi nayo ayehe, omukwaniilwa ota mono kutya Daniel nookuume ke yatatu oyo ya kotoka lela. Ano ote ya kaleke puye oku mu yakula muuwa. Nuuna omukwaniilwa ta pula Daniel, Sadrak, Meshak naAbednego omapulo nenge omaupyakadhi omadhigu, yo oye shi shi unene lwiikando 10 ye vulithe kehe gumwe gwomaasaaseri nenge aalumentu ye aanongo. Daniel 1:1-21.

OOMVULA dhi vulithe 10 odha piti po okuza sho Omukwaniilwa Nebukadnesar a fala aalongwantu ayehe Aaisrael kuBabilon. Nongashingeyi tala shoka tashi ningwa po! Jerusalem otashi fikwa po. Aaisrael mboka inaaya dhipagwa otaa falwa kuBabilon oyo oonkwatwa.

Dhimbulukwa, osho shoka aaprofeti yaJehova ya londodha tashi ka ningwa ngele aantu itaya lundulula omikalo dhawo omiwinayi. Ihe Aaisrael inaya pulakena kaaprofeti. Yo oya tsikile nokulongela iikalunga pehala lyokulongela Jehova. Ano aantu oyi ilongele egeelo. Tse otu shi shi, oshoka omuprofeti gwaKalunga Hesekiel ote tu hokololele kombinga yiinima iiwinayi mbyoka Aaisrael ya ningi.

Owa tseya kutya Hesekiel oye lye? Oye gumwe gwomaalumentu aagundjuka mboka Omukwaniilwa Nebukadnesar a fala kuBabilon oomvula dhi vulithe po 10 komeho yehanagulo ndika enene lyaJerusalem. Daniel nookuume ke yatatu, Sadrak, Meshak na-Abednego, pethimbo opo tuu mpono nayo wo oya falwa kuBabilon.

Manga Hesekiel e li muBabilon, Jehova ote mu ulukile iinima iiwinayi mbyoka tayi ningwa potempeli muJerusalem. Jehova ote shi ningi mokupitila moshikumithalonga. Hesekiel oku li lela natango muBabilon, ihe Jehova ote mu monitha ayihe mbyoka tayi ningwa potempeli. Niinima mbyoka Hesekiel e wete oyo iitilithi!

‘Tala kiinima yiihuna mbyoka aantu taa ningi mpaka potempeli,’ Jehova ta lombwele Hesekiel. ‘Tala komakuma ga andekwa nomafano gomayoka niinamwenyo yilwe. Nou tale nkene Aaisrael taye yi galikana!’ Hesekiel ota vulu okumona iinima mbika, nota nyola shoka tashi ningwa.

‘Ou wete shoka aaleli Aaisrael taa ningi meholamo?’ Jehova ta pula Hesekiel. Eeno, ye ota vulu wo oku shi mona. Opu na aalumentu 70, ayehe otaa galikana iikalunga. Yo otaa ti: ‘Jehova ke tu wete. Ye okwa thiga po oshilongo.’

Opo nduno Jehova otu ulukile Hesekiel aakiintu yamwe peyelo lyokuumbangalantu lyotempeli. Yo oya kuutumba mpoka notaa galikana oshikalunga Tammus. Tala kaalumentu mbeyaka mehale lyotempeli yaJehova! Opu na 25 lwaampono. Hesekiel oku ya wete. Yo otaa petama ya taalela kuuzilo notaa galikana etango!

‘Aantu mbaka kaye na esimaneko nangame,’ Jehova ta ti. ‘Yo itaa longo owala uuwinayi, ihe otaye ya ye u ningile lelalela potempeli yandje!’ Ano Jehova otu uvaneke: ‘Yo otaa ka mona nkene ngame nda geya. Noitandi ke ya etela ohenda uuna yo taa hanagulwa po.’ Konyala konima owala yoomvula ndatu okuza sho Jehova u ulikile Hesekiel iinima mbika, Aaisrael oya tsu ondumbo nOmukwaniilwa Nebukadnesar. Ano ye ota yi e ke ya kondjithe. Konima yomvula netata Aababilon otayu ulula omankolokuma gaJerusalem notaa fike po oshilando ashihe. Aantu oyendji otaa dhipagwa nenge taa falwa kuBabilon oyo oonkwatwa.

Omolwashike mbela Jehova a pitika ehanagulo ndino lyAaisrael etilithi? Omolwashoka yo inaa pulakena kuJehova noinaa vulika koompango dhe. Otashi ulike nkene sha simana kutya tse tu longe aluhe shoka Kalunga ta ti.

Tango aantu aashona oyo taa pitikwa ya kale muIsrael. Omukwaniilwa Nebukadnesar ota tula po Omujuda gwedhina Gedalia okutonatela aantu mbaka. Ihe opo nduno Aaisrael yamwe otaa dhipaga Gedalia. Ngashingeyi aantu oya tila kutya Aababilon otaye ke ya ye ya hanagule po ayehe molwoshilonga shika oshiwinayi. Ano yo otaa yi ontuku kuEgipiti notaa thiminike Jeremia a ye pamwe nayo.

Otashi kalitha oshilongo shaIsrael shaa na aantu. Uule woomvula 70 moshilongo mwaa na omuntu. Oshi li owalaelela. Ihe Jehova otu uvaneke kutya ye ota ka galulila oshigwana she koshilongo konima yoomvula 70. Oshike mbela tashi ningilwa oshigwana shaKalunga pokati mpono moshilongo shaBabilon hoka yo ya falwa? Natu tale. 2 Aakwaniilwa 25:1-26; Jeremia 29:10; Hesekiel 1:1-3; 8:1-18.
